passive.name: New Destiny
passive.description: Graves' shotgun has some unique properties. He must reload when he runs out of ammo. Attacks fire 4 bullets, which cannot pass through units. Non-champions struck by multiple bullets are knocked back.

spells.name: End of the Line
spells.description: Graves fires a powder round dealing physical damage. After 1 second or after colliding with terrain, it detonates, dealing physical damage along the travel path again and to enemies near the blast.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Smoke Screen
spells.description: Graves creates a cloud of black smoke for 4 seconds, Slowing enemies inside by % and blocking their vision outside the area. The initial impact deals magic damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation ImpactDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Quickdraw
spells.description: Graves dashes and reloads one Shell into his shotgun. He also gains a stack for seconds (max stacks) or two stacks if he dashes towards an enemy champion. Stacks grant him Armor and Magic Resist. Stacks are refreshed when damaging a non-minion. Each bullet hit from Graves' Attacks reduces this Ability's Cooldown by seconds.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: Collateral Damage
spells.description: Graves fires an explosive cartridge, blasting himself backwards. The cartridge deals physical damage to the first enemy hit. After hitting an enemy champion or reaching the end of its range, the cartridge explodes outward, dealing physical damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation Damage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
